beIN SPORTS 3.title_fr: Bournemouth vs Sunderland - Premier League anglaise 2026/2027 - 7ème journée
beIN SPORTS 3.desc_en: Bournemouth have won two of their 10 league games against Sunderland, though both were in the Premier League in September 2015 and April 2017. Sunderland have won four of their six away games against Bournemouth in all competitions, with last season’s Premier League meeting at the Vitality Stadium ending 1-1.
beIN SPORTS 3.desc_fr: Bournemouth a remporté deux de ses 10 matches de championnat contre Sunderland, même si les deux étaient en Premier League en septembre 2015 et avril 2017.
